operations.command: set -e; . /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh; root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root); if NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=unapplied456 nixosctl change-password --update-tpm2 > /tmp/e2e-tpm-preflight.log 2>&1; then cat /tmp/e2e-tpm-preflight.log; exit 1; fi; grep -F "Managed TPM enrollment is unavailable; no passwords changed" /tmp/e2e-tpm-preflight.log; printf %s testpass123 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root"; if printf %s unapplied456 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root"; then exit 1; fi; accepts testpass123; if accepts unapplied456; then exit 1; fi; printf tpm-preflight-preserved-both

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root) && NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass456 nixosctl change-password --full-disk-encryption-only > /tmp/e2e-luks.log 2>&1 && printf %s newpass456 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root" && ! printf %s testpass123 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root" && accepts testpass123 && printf luks-changed || { cat /tmp/e2e-luks.log; exit 1; }

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root) && printf %s newpass456 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root" && accepts testpass123 && printf luks-survived-reboot || { cryptsetup luksDump "$root"; exit 1; }

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root) && NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass456 nixosctl change-password > /tmp/e2e-both.log 2>&1 && grep -F 'LUKS already unlocks' /tmp/e2e-both.log && accepts newpass456 && test "$(printf %s newpass456 | crypt)" = "$(cat /var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash)" && printf converged-both || { cat /tmp/e2e-both.log; exit 1; }

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root) && NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass456 nixosctl change-password > /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log 2>&1 && grep -F 'LUKS already unlocks' /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log && grep -F 'already uses the new password' /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log && printf idempotent || { cat /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log; exit 1; }
